title: Aloe: A Family of Fine-tuned Open Healthcare LLMs
findings: The final aligned model, Llama3-Aloe-8B-Alpha, showed a slight improvement in safety against generating hateful content (which includes religiously hateful content) compared to its pre-alignment version. The Attack Success Rate for the general 'Hate' topic decreased from 0.55 to 0.53 after the final alignment stage. The paper does not provide a breakdown of these results specifically for religion.
